# J&L African Hair Braiding

> African hair braiding studio based in Austin, Texas. Box, knotless and goddess braids done neat and gentle by Jackie in her north Austin studio. Clients say they leave with compliments, no sore scalp and a fair price.

## Services
- Knotless individual braids: Individual knotless braids that start flat at the root, so they feel light and look natural from day one.
- Box braids: Classic box braids with neat square parts in a clean tiled pattern, finished straight or with curly ends.
- Goddess braids: Braids with soft curls left through the length for a full, feminine goddess look.
- Boho & colour braids: Boho curls, ombre and two-tone blends like honey, copper, burgundy and blonde. Bring your inspiration photo.
- Crochet braids: Extensions attached through your natural hair for a full-bodied, protective look in less chair time.
- Cornrows & bantu knots: Cornrows braided close to the scalp for chic raised braids, plus stitch styles and bantu knots.

## About
J&L African Hair Braiding is Jackie Wara's braiding studio at 6309 Melrose Trail in north Austin, near Wells Branch and Quail Creek. Clients come in for knotless and box braids, goddess and boho curls, crochet braids, kinky twists and cornrows, and they keep coming back. What clients notice most: braids that are neat and tight but never painful, good communication, and being in and out in a few hours. Jackie speaks English and French. Book your style and time on StyleSeat, or call or text first if you have questions.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: How do I book?
  A: Book online on StyleSeat: pick your style and an open time. A deposit is paid when you book to hold your spot. You can also call or text (832) 419-7978.
- Q: How much do braids cost?
  A: Cornrows start at $65, bantu knots and takedowns are $70, crochet braids $150, goddess and knotless individual braids $200, and box braids and kinky twists $240. Longer lengths cost more; your exact price shows when you book.
- Q: Is the hair included?
  A: Yes for knotless individual braids and kinky twists. For other styles, ask when you book and Jackie will tell you what hair and how many packs you need.
- Q: How long does an appointment take?
  A: Cornrows take about 1 hour 45 minutes, crochet braids about 2.5 hours, and box, knotless and goddess braids about 5 hours. Kinky twists take about 6 hours.
- Q: What if I need to cancel?
  A: Reschedule or cancel at least 24 hours ahead. Deposits are non-refundable, and late cancellations or no-shows are charged part of the service price.
- Q: Do braids hurt?
  A: They should not. Clients say their braids came out tight and neat with no pain. Speak up if anything feels too tight.
